newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.481 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.481 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.481 percent, unchanged from the previous issue, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on February 13, raised 869.6 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.627 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on February 6, raised 1,119.8 million and was priced at 99.623 percent.
